# What counts as a needs-you or permission predicate, and which files are test code. Both
# guards read this file: src-tauri/crates/codesense-guards/tests/needs_you_predicates_guard.rs
# for Rust, and src/shared/lib/needs-you-predicates.guard.test.ts for the frontend and docs.
#
# A line is `<rule> <value>`; the value runs to the end of the line.
#   literal  text a line contains once its spaces are dropped and ' reads as "
#   arm      a state named in a match arm: on a line with `=>`, followed by `|` or `=>`
#            or preceded by `|`
#   ident    an identifier, matched whole
#   prefix   with stem: an identifier that starts with a prefix and then names a stem,
#            camelCase (`isNeedsMark`) or snake_case (`is_needs_mark`)
#   test-name, test-name-suffix, test-name-part, test-dir: a file that is test code, by
#            its whole name, the end of its name, part of its name, or a directory
#   hit, miss: example lines each guard must and must not flag

literal "needs-permission"
literal "needs-you"
literal "needs_you"
literal =="needs"
literal !="needs"
literal "needs"==
literal "needs"!=
literal case"needs"
literal =="permission"
literal !="permission"
literal "permission"==
literal "permission"!=
literal case"permission"

arm "needs"
arm "permission"

ident needsYouKind
ident needs_you_kind
ident NeedsPermission
ident needsYouBySender
ident needsMailBySender
ident needsBySender
ident ASK_USER_STATE
ident kindOf
ident needsYouCount
ident needs_you_count
ident needsYouTotal
ident needs_you_total
ident needs_you_run
ident record_needs_you

prefix is
prefix has
prefix select
prefix get
prefix count
prefix use
stem Needs

test-name tests.rs
test-name-suffix _tests.rs
test-name-part .test.
test-name-part .spec.
test-dir /tests/
test-dir /evals/
